articles.summary: First scientific presentation of Phase 3 DAYBREAK results for Zenkuda and tabirafusp-ted in wet age-related macular degeneration scheduled for AAO 2026. Additional presentations include Phase 3 GLOW2 data for Zenkuda in diabetic retinopathy and Phase 1b APEX data for KSI-101 in macular edema
articles.title: Kodiak Sciences to Present Clinical Data Across All Three Late-Stage Programs at AAO 2026
